summary: Liberty Defense Holdings, Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with a press release dated September 8, 2026, announcing the first public showing of its HEXWAVE I-Configuration at GSX 2026 in Atlanta, September 14–16. The product is a single-panel concealed-weapons detection system using millimeter wave technology. No special-situation transaction is involved—no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic change. The filing is a routine product launch and marketing announcement under Rule 13a-16. Category is therefore None.
